text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come to a shrine with Ines Fujin,
who's been
in something of a funk lately.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You know, I've actually worked here as a
shrine
maiden before. Well, it was more
volunteering
than working.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I had some initial training where I was
taught the
traditional way to bow and
walk. And they shared
some Shinto
teachings with me too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm going to use what I learned
back then
to reach out to the gods and
have them hear my
troubles.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
O divine spirits, I thank you for your
continued
protection and guidance, and
ask that you
continue to watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's my praying done. All that's
left is to
put in the work on my side.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a moment? I have a
question about
the god of this shrine.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but today's my first day
here. I'm not
very knowledgeable on the
subject yet...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I know about that stuff, so I can
answer your
question!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Visitor
text_block_list.text:
How illuminating! Thank you very much
for your
thorough explanation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And thank you, too—for being such a
patient
listener!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I got to help out at the shrine
again. Good
thing I paid attention when
I was on maiden duty
before. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her prayers answered, Ines Fujin regains
her
energy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I remember hearing about the god
of this
shrine when I was a shrine maiden!
You see, well,
um...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Uh... W-wait, huh? I keep drawing
blanks... Urk,
the gods won't like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Disappointed in herself, Ines Fujin
struggles to
shake off her doldrums.
